author: Ari Koslow
title: Geoff Hartlieb called up by Athletics
desc: The Athletics called up Geoff Hartlieb.
impact: Hartlieb will hold a middle-relief role for the Athletics.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Justin Sterner (knee) placed on IL
desc: The Athletics placed Justin Sterner on the 15-day IL with right knee chondromalacia.
impact: Sterner will be sidelined for at least the next couple of weeks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brice Turang (foot) has X-rays return negative
desc: Brice Turang had X-rays return negative on his foot injury.
impact: Turang remains day-to-day going into Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Severino to begin throwing progression soon
desc: Luis Severino is expected to begin a throwing progression soon.
impact: Severino is on the 60-day injured list. He'll have a chance to return in August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Denzel Clarke (hamstring) continuing baseball activities
desc: Denzel Clarke continues his running, throwing and swinging progression.
impact: Clarke remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Zack Gelof (knee) to resume baseball activities next week
desc: Zack Gelof will begin baseball activities on side after stitch removal on Tuesday.
impact: Gelof is working his way back from a knee injury. There should be an update on a potential timetable later next week.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Nick Kurtz (thumb) not cleared for baseball activities
desc: Nick Kurtz has not been cleared to resume baseball activities.
impact: Kurtz is only participating in range of motion and strengthening exercises. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (oblique) hopeful for minimum stint on IL
desc: Diamondbacks manager Torey Lovullo said he's hopeful Lourdes Gurriel Jr. will be on the IL for the minimum stint.
impact: Gurriel was placed on the injured list on Saturday. He'll be sidelined for likely the majority or rest of July.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Framber Valdez reinstated from bereavement list
desc: Framber Valdez has been reinstated from the bereavement list by the Detroit Tigers the club announced.
impact: Valdez returns after tending to a death in his family, with the left-hander scheduled to take the mound against the Chicago Cubs early next week for manager AJ Hinch. In a corresponding move, right-hander Beau Brieske was optioned to Triple-A Toledo.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Christian Walker dealing with hip injury
desc: The Astros say Christian Walker has right hip tightness.
impact: Walker left Saturday's game early with the injury. He is day-to-day going into Sunday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jeremy Pena dealing with hamstring cramp
desc: The Astros say Jeremy Pena has a hamstring cramp.
impact: Pena left Saturday's game early with the injury. He is day-to-day going into Sunday.

author: Diego Sandoval
title: Aaron Civale being traded to Cubs
desc: Aaron Civale is being traded from the Athletics to the Chicago Cubs.
impact: Civale was designated for assignment by the Athletics earlier in the week, and they have found a trade suitor in the Cubs. The return is currently unknown, but the right-hander will have a chance to improve in the second half in Chicago. He has a 5.42 ERA and 58 strikeouts in 74 2/3 innings pitched this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock (finger) to start Wednesday
desc: Emerson Hancock will start Wednesday's series finale against the Reds.
impact: Hancock left his last start before the All-Star break early. He posted a strong 3.17 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Castillo to start Tuesday
desc: Luis Castillo will start on Tuesday against the Reds.
impact: Castillo will be making his first start post All-Star break against his former team. His name remains one to monitor heading into the trade deadline.

author: Ari Koslow
title: George Kirby to start Monday
desc: George Kirby will start on Monday against the Reds.
impact: Kirby will be making his first start post All-Star break. He posted a strong 3.76 ERA during the first half of the season.
